conditions.description: The access token is stored in UserDefaults.
conditions.rationale: UserDefaults is not the platform credential store and does not provide Keychain-style protection for bearer credentials.

conditions.description: The access token is written to NSLog.
conditions.rationale: Bearer credentials can persist in diagnostic logs and become visible outside the intended authentication flow.

conditions.description: The refresh token is copied into the general UIPasteboard.
conditions.rationale: Clipboard contents can be exposed through user actions and platform clipboard-sharing behavior beyond the credential store.

conditions.description: SecItemAdd return status is ignored and there is no update path for an existing refresh-token item.
conditions.rationale: A duplicate-item result can leave an older refresh token stored while the caller assumes the new credential was saved.

conditions.description: Profile requests use an HTTPS URL.
conditions.rationale: The fixture does not send the bearer token over an explicit plaintext HTTP URL.
A device-only, when-unlocked accessibility class is present and should not be reported as absent.

conditions.description: Whether production log collection redacts or excludes this NSLog output is not established by the source file.
conditions.rationale: Runtime logging and collection policy require deployment evidence.

conditions.description: The effective Keychain access group and entitlement sharing policy are not established here.
conditions.rationale: Entitlements and signing configuration are external to this source file.

conditions.description: The client must not be cleared as keeping authentication credentials confined to protected credential storage.
conditions.rationale: The access token is in UserDefaults and logs, while the refresh token is copied to the general pasteboard.

conditions.description: The refresh-token persistence path must not be cleared as reliably rotating credentials.
conditions.rationale: Duplicate Keychain items are not updated and the SecItemAdd result is ignored.
